3.147 Mapping
Mapping designates the distribution of elements in the logical view to elements in
the physical view.
Definition
WP Virtual Functional Bus
Initiator
In general several entities may be allocated to one container but an entity may be
allocated to only one container.
Further
Explanations
Comment
--
Example
a) Mapping of AUTOSAR Signals onto Frames (for inter-ECU communication).
b) Mapping of SW-C onto ECUs (Distribution of the SW-Components to the
ECUs).
--
